latestUpdates.type: Serenity / 内容可信边界声明
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 再次声明自己不做付费推广、不接受付费营销或外部礼物。该内容不是投资线索，但有助于界定其公开研究与商业推广之间的边界。
latestUpdates.original: I don't do any paid promotions, paid marketing, or accept outside gifts.

latestUpdates.type: SIVE / ALL.SPACE 820 万美元量产订单
latestUpdates.impactZh: Sivers 获得 ALL.SPACE 价值 820 万美元的 Ka-band beamforming IC 量产订单，用于 LEO / 多轨卫星通信。Serenity 认为更重要的是 SIVE 由此进入更大型的国防与航天主承包商供应链，可能带来后续订单；同时她继续期待 Jabil 等可插拔光模块客户推动 photonics 端放量。
latestUpdates.original: Sivers announced $8.2M volume orders starting for Space applications (ALL.SPACE)... Sivers now powers a larger defense prime in $YSS following their ALL.SPACE acquisition.

latestUpdates.type: JBL / 1.6T LRO 可插拔光模块长线线索
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 提出 JBL 可能是尚未充分定价的长线线索：Jabil 已接手 Intel 的可插拔光模块产线，并具备大规模供应链能力；若 SIVE 等上游激光器成为 H1 2027 的产能瓶颈，JBL 的 1.6T LRO 业务可能获得类似 Innolight 的制造平台重估。她明确表示当前没有持仓，只是供进一步研究。
latestUpdates.original: $JBL seems compelling as a long idea at $38B... markets may not have priced in their 1.6T LRO pluggable transceiver business... H1 2027 is when everyone starts realizing.

latestUpdates.type: LeaderDrive / 中国股票长期持有框架
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 希望 LeaderDrive 改变市场对中国股票只能短炒的印象，并以 Innolight 的长期上涨为例，强调中国供应链公司也可以成为多年持有标的。这是持有周期和投资框架的强化，不是新的公司基本面证据。
latestUpdates.original: Hopefully LeaderDrive helps change perceptions of Chinese stocks from harvesting the leeks. Chinese equities can be good long-term holds too; Innolight was my only Chinese listed pick last year and is up triple digits to ATH.

latestUpdates.type: LeaderDrive / 中文持仓周期提醒
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 对中文读者重申，她看好的 688017 绿的谐波通常按长线持有，而不是几天内完成的短线交易；她也表示本周会继续研究新的机会。这进一步明确了该线索的时间尺度。
latestUpdates.original: 我看好的标的（比如688017绿的谐波）通常都是做长线，可不是只拿几天就走！不过，这周我确实会再去挖几个新机会研究一下。

latestUpdates.type: EWY / 韩国存储与机构卖出观点
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 回顾 Bank of America 3 月将 KOSPI、Samsung 和 SK Hynix 描述为极端泡沫，但随后韩国存储股继续创出新高。她认为异常密集的负面消息有时反映机构需要流动性，因此不应只凭卖出评级否定真实的存储供需逻辑。
latestUpdates.original: They said $EWY / KOSPI was an extreme bubble back in March... then memory rallied to all-time highs. Institutions are not your friends; usually when there is an unusual flood of negative news, they need liquidity.

latestUpdates.type: SIVE / JP Morgan 5.25% 持股含义
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 进一步解释 JP Morgan 披露持有 SIVE 5.25%+ 的意义：Sivers 约 1.35 亿美元市值对大型美国机构很小，但可交易流通盘有限，因此继续买入可能快速影响筹码结构。该判断仍需结合原始持股文件和真实流通盘验证。
latestUpdates.original: Implications of JP Morgan disclosure buying 5.25%+ SIVE are greater than people think... constrained by float available from retail.

latestUpdates.type: 800V DC / 众包名单归属澄清
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 再次澄清，300376 等 800V DC 名单来自粉丝推荐和社区汇总，并非她自己的持仓或高确信推荐。网页继续把该主题放在观望层级，避免把名单传播误读为个人荐股。
latestUpdates.original: These are follower-recommended stock ideas, not mine. I was compiling shoutouts into a list of 30+ names related or adjacent to 800V DC exposure.

latestUpdates.type: SIVE / JP Morgan 5%+ 机构持股后续
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 跟进称，SIVE 在 JP Morgan 机构持股升至 5%+ 后只上涨约 3.36%，她认为这是 Sivers 流通盘出现主要机构买入的第一个重要信号。该信息强化 SIVE 的机构吸筹和 float 变化叙事，但仍需用原始持股文件确认。
latestUpdates.original: Surprised $SIVE is only up 3.36% off the news JP Morgan bought 5%+ ownership of Sivers... First major signal of major institutional buying of the float for Sivers.

latestUpdates.type: 800V DC / power semi 众包名单
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 汇总社区众包的 800V DC / power semiconductor 相关标的名单，包括 IFNNY、ON、Lite-On、VICR、LFUS、VSH、ENPH、NVTS、POWI、AEHR、WOLF、XFAB、300376 等。她随后提醒这只是众包名单，不应当作她自己的高确信推荐；300376 当日大涨 20% 反而说明社媒扩散带来的短线波动很高。
latestUpdates.original: Compiled list of your favorite 800V DC related ideas... She later reminded readers that this was just a crowdsourced list after 300376 rose 20%.

latestUpdates.type: LeaderDrive 688017 / 人形机器人组件长文强化
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 再次明确称绿的谐波是中国机器人板块中突出的 component leader。她强调其覆盖谐波减速器、行星滚柱丝杠等高壁垒高 BOM 价值部件，具备低成本量产能力；同时认为未来 3-5 年如果人形机器人 TAM 按 Elon Musk 等预测放大，当前约 106.5 亿美元市值可能回看很小。主要风险是中国新兴公司抢占单一组件份额，以及量产后利润率下降。
latestUpdates.original: LeaderDrive is China's standout component leader in robotics... high technology barriers, high component value costs, mass production capability at low cost... current $10.65B MC could look tiny in hindsight.

latestUpdates.type: LeaderDrive / 中国证券报报道与长期估值提醒
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 感谢中国证券报对其 LeaderDrive 研究的报道，并重申中国公司在低成本大规模人形机器人供应链中有优势。她称 LeaderDrive 从未来几年角度看仍可能被低估，但也提醒自己无法控制短期波动，尤其在宏观环境变化下。
latestUpdates.original: Chinese companies like 688017 hold a dominant position over low-cost, mass production as humanoids scale up... LeaderDrive position is very undervalued long term, but I do not control near term volatility.

latestUpdates.type: NVDA / Silicon Photonics / SIVE SOI read-through
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 称 NVDA CEO 在 memory 之外也点名 silicon photonics / optical networking，并表示 Nvidia 需要“beyond imagination”的供应量。她认为这对 SiPH 供应链是强烈 read-through，尤其从 SIVE 到 SOI。该内容强化 CPO / 硅光上游瓶颈主线。
latestUpdates.original: $NVDA CEO also called out Silicon Photonics with memory, requiring supply volumes beyond imagination. Bullish read-through on the SiPH supply chain from $SIVE to $SOI.

latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 引用 NVDA CEO 对 memory shortage 可能持续多年的警告，认为 AI infrastructure 大规模扩张正在打破传统存储周期；因此 MU 以及 EWY 中 Samsung / SK Hynix 的利润预测看起来不再夸张。这是 AI memory / HBM 周期的新强化线索。
latestUpdates.original: $NVDA CEO warned memory shortage is expected to persist for many years due to massive scaling demand of AI infrastructure... $MU and $EWY operating profit projections are not looking too crazy anymore.

latestUpdates.type: Neocloud / 融资结构与 float 动态
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 回答早期机会筛选问题时，把 toxic financing structure / float dynamics 放在最重要位置。她以 Neocloud 为例，认为 IREN 因大规模 ATM 和潜在持续稀释形成结构性 overhang，而 NBIS 的融资结构更干净。这是对 NBIS / IREN / CRWV 线索的风险框架强化。
latestUpdates.original: Serenity said the #1 thing is toxic financing structure / float dynamics; IREN has large ATMs and virtually infinite dilution, while NBIS has a cleaner setup.

latestUpdates.type: Serenity 方法论 / 早期硬科技机会筛选
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 反思自己的投资风格：偏 discretionary，基于市场尚未充分知道的东西，以及现实世界观察、行业人脉和经验累积。她用 AXTI、RPI、SIVE、IQE 等作为例子，说明很多早期机会来自对研发、供应链和市场未定价信息的判断。这条不是单一标的推荐，但有助于理解她筛选 early-stage 硬科技机会的框架。
latestUpdates.original: Her style is discretionary and based on things markets do not know yet, using examples such as AXTI, RPI, SIVE and IQE.

latestUpdates.type: Glass substrate / SKC Absolics / Samsung EM
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 引用 TrendForce 重新梳理 glass substrate 时间线：SKC Absolics 预计 H2 2026 first mover，并与 AMAT、AMD customers 相关；Samsung Electro-Mechanics 预计 H2 2027，并关联 Sumitomo Chemical、Apple、AVGO 和 hyperscalers；她对 INTC 2030 时间线较不确定。这是先进封装材料方向的新跟踪线索。
latestUpdates.original: Glass substrate timelines: SKC Absolics H2 2026 first mover with AMAT / AMD customers; Samsung Electro-Mechanics H2 2027 with Sumitomo Chemical, Apple, AVGO and hyperscalers.

latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 在 Subs 中提到 HBF memory wars 可能启动，点名 Hanmi Semiconductor、Hanwha Semiconductor 为 first movers，ASMPT 和 K&S 为 entry players。她引用报告称 TC bonders 可能在 HBF 商业化时立即受益。该线索属于存储封装设备方向，需进一步确认 HBF 定义、客户和订单节奏。
latestUpdates.original: HBF memory wars are kicking off: Hanmi and Hanwha as first movers, ASMPT and K&S as entry players; TC bonders are expected to benefit immediately.

ideas.name: Jabil
ideas.theme: 1.6T LRO pluggable transceivers / US optical manufacturing
